concept: Noisy quantum subspace eigenproblems need conditional stability analysis
summary: Projected generalized eigenproblems can be ill-conditioned; truncation-based stability results require assumptions.

limitations: No universal truncation threshold or shot budget follows from the abstract.

implications: Assess overlap conditioning and measurement uncertainty before recommending a quantum diagonalization workflow.
